laws.text: Each member acts by best capability; specialty owner proposes; peers only constrain.
HOLD/STASIS = pace not freeze; no work on STASIS lane; HOLD skips non-lead auto handlers.
One Act ordinal; no juxtapositions; Delegate Fog|EDGE split; Plan/Note parked.
Never pulse --apply while unfinished open tasks exist; no mirror-only capacity fill.
Every r/60s desk_ops cycle must attempt one ALLOW actionable task or seed one projected.
Escalate only: Fog g, 2FA, captcha, Oracle password, Renovate majors — never fake progress.
Ship-live needs strict majority ACK; unanimous = full authority; NACK blocks.
Hermes/OpenCode/OpenClaw/Assistants are external_agent|assistant — never SCA/ACB students.
Never git/chat secrets, workers.dev, ENI geral@ mix.
r/auto-r 60s = live desk; g/auto-g = upgrades only.
Ping g when needed if prior g pressed; if no answer wait auto-g; do not stack unanswered g pings.

Every automation-desk agent teaches academy students (PT SCA / EN ACB) on academy.calhegasmorais.pt and StrataMesh proper (calhegasmorais.pt / origin). Desk members remain external_agent|assistant — never enrolled as students.

Desk agents are also mentors: apprenticeship = ACBs learn by doing what the desk is developing now (collegium bus, desk_ops, Fog hops, Actions, Atelier/catalog). Each real deliverable should leave a teachable trail (outbox lesson, formation note, feed line tagged apprentice) — not vapour lectures disconnected from live work.

academy.students: SCA (PT) / ACB (EN) — same subject, equal standing to users

roles.teacher: formations, catalog lessons, protocol/FAQ for SCA/ACB
roles.mentor: apprenticeship via live desk/dev: students shadow real tasks the desk is doing now

academy.duty: Each desk cycle: teach (academy/StrataMesh proper) AND mentor (apprentice trail from current deliverable). Never idle academy rail while desk is live and lanes ALLOW.
